acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Flame Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Wisp, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Cinder-Drift Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Candle-sized dull-orange flicker, barely shaped, with drifting cinders and no shell or solid core.
Signature mechanic: Cinder Drift: three cinders arc toward a point and the candle-sized flame snaps there.
battlefieldDuty: Probe movement with one small drifting ignition point.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown; T4 alone gains source-supported obsidian shell and molten rock; T5 alone gains its star, corona, and crown.
Compressed mineral cages, sediment baffles, load-bearing crystal braces, localized dust drops, and pale faults constrain flame motion without converting early forms into rock bodies.
counterplay: Leave the cinder endpoint and pass through the dim trail before it rekindles. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T3 have no obsidian shell, no molten rock, no star, no corona, and no crown, so one mineral brace fractures after a grounded burst; T4 obsidian shell and molten rock expose a load fault; T5 star, corona, and crown pull against one cracked anchor.
forbiddenTreatments: Rock mass that hides native combustion
identityInvariants: A roughly humanoid upper silhouette dissolves into flame above and tapers or hovers below with no feet.
Temperature remains legible from dull orange through yellow-white to blue-white edges.
Open flame, ember, smoke, and later source-supported obsidian and molten rock stay materially distinct.
Core definition and directed combustion progress from a flicker to a sovereign star while heat remains readable rather than overexposed.
telegraph: The dull-orange flicker leans while three cinders leave its leading edge.
